auth_key_file.description: Location of the client's private DSA key in PEM format. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#AuthKeyFile	= /etc/isns/auth_key).

auth_replay_window.description: Time window for replay attack prevention verification.

auth_timestamp_jitter.description: Time stamp jitter for authentication blocks.

security.description: Authentication enable/disable. 1 means signed messages are used if keys are present. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#Security	= 1).

server_address.description: Name and port of the iSNS server (e.g., isns.example.com, isns.example.com:3205, or SLP:). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ServerAddress	= isns.example.com).

server_key_file.description: Location of the server's public DSA key in PEM format. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ServerKeyFile	= /etc/isns/server_key.pub).

source_name.description: The source name (iSCSI qualified name) identifying the client uniquely. If empty, derived from hostname. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#SourceName	= iqn.2006-01.com.example.host1).
